title: Edits
description: The one hand file. Catalog records no register gives, and patches to records a register gives.

additionalProperties.description: A full record or a patch, keyed by catalog id. May set any catalog field except id, source and status. label and identifier merge per key; endpoint merges per (protocol, url); same_as is a union; other fields override.

ignore.description: Catalog ids or URLs a register offers that are not catalogs: dead registrations, duplicates, test installs.
